header: This is the full-screen viewer layer, written once: the dark blurred layer over the page, with a header that holds the cross (to close) and the title, and room below for whatever is being viewed. I use it as the layer of the circular viewer (src/components/CircularViewerLightbox.tsx, whose pages are pictures) and of the announcement PDF viewer (src/components/AnnouncementPdfViewer.tsx, whose body is the PDF), so that both look and close the same way. Nothing here knows what is shown: the caller puts its own canvas in `children`.
